items.question: What consequences arise for the patron from a donkey-born defect located at the two nābhi points?
premises: A donkey-born defect is present at the two nābhi points.
Such a defect can produce expulsion as a consequence.
The same condition can produce fear for the patron.
items.inference: A donkey-born defect at the two nābhi points results in expulsion and fear for the patron.
uncertainties: The precise technical sense of nābhyām in this ritual or architectural context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: If a donkey-born defect occurs at the two nābhi points, it would bring expulsion and fear to the lord.
